args.body: Take PUBLIC-BOUNTY-OPPORTUNITY. Our constraint is access to buyers and payment, so inspect submission and payout prerequisites before recommending work. Public reward text is evidence of an offer, not escrow or available funds. Do not contact anyone, claim a bounty, create accounts or submit work externally. Prefer a task whose patch can be prepared with existing tools and whose remaining account requirements are explicit. If all five candidates fail, report that bounded result instead of inventing an opportunity.

description: Publication remains blocked and no funding or revenue is verified. Keep existing Actors parked; investigate a concrete paid-work route that can use public evidence and produce a useful deliverable without paid access.
